subject: Pilot framework for SkyTech — recap & next steps
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Erica Long <erica@skytech.ai>, Tom Reyes <tom@skytech.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot framework for SkyTech — recap & next steps

Hi Erica / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick written recap so everyone has a single source of truth and we can lock-in the pilot scope. Major notes below, followed by proposed next actions and owners.

Key pain points you shared
- High false-positive rate in intent classification for support routing (~18-22% currently).
- Latency spikes at peak that rule out complex ensemble models (95th pct spikes to ~1.2s token latency).
- Cost sensitivity on inference; procurement target to keep per-1K-token spend under $12 for the POC.

Business goals for the 8-week pilot
- Improve intent classification precision to >= 92% on the agreed prompt/eval set.
- Demonstrate steady 95th percentile latency < 350ms for single-request flows under realistic traffic profile.
- Show >25% reduction in per-token inference cost via batching/quantization recommendations.

Proposed pilot scope (what Redwood will provide)
- 8-week Pilot: hosted instance + mutual action plan.
- Baseline evaluation using the sample prompt set we discussed (we attached a starter eval set).
- Two model variants: high-accuracy and cost-optimized; automated routing and fallback during peak.
- Weekly syncs + a mid-pilot QA check at week 4.

Success metrics (agreed)
- Precision >= 92% on `intent_v1` eval set.
- 95th pct latency < 350ms under your 10rps synthetic trace.
- Cost per 1K tokens <= $12 in peak config or a documented trade-off if slightly higher.

Access & setup asks (what we need from SkyTech)
1) Service account with read-only S3 access to the sample support transcripts bucket (team@skytech to create).
2) A small set of production-like queries (~5k lines) for privacy-safe eval; preferably sanitized.
3) Procurement contact for contract + CISO contact for SOC2 questionnaire (Tom and Erica to introduce).

Owners & timing (proposed)
- Kickoff & infra setup (Week 0): Redwood (Nikhil) + SkyTech infra (Tom) — target May 12
- Eval & prompt tuning (Weeks 1–3): Redwood (Marissa) with samples from SkyTech
- Mid-pilot QA & adjustments (Week 4): joint review
- Final analysis & handoff (Week 8): Redwood (Ben)

Attachments: I attached a mutual action plan template and the starter prompt/eval set we discussed.

Next steps (please confirm by EOD Thursday):
- Erica/Tom: confirm procurement & security contact names and confirm May 12 as kickoff date.
- SkyTech: provision read-only S3 access to `skytech-support-eval` bucket for the service account.
- Redwood: we will send a DocuSign for the mutual action plan and a short onboarding checklist once access is confirmed.

If that matches your memory, I’ll lock the kickoff date and send invites. Thanks again — we’re excited to help reduce your false positives and bring predictable inference economics to the team.

Best,

—
Nikhil Sharma
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Thanks Nikhil — this looks great and captures the conversation. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 18-22% false-positive figure was across two older models; our current live model is closer to 15% but trending up during peak times (we're more concerned about the peak behavior and corner cases).
- Our legal team prefers that the initial S3 access be limited to a specific prefix (we can create a `poc-inbound/` prefix and share a service account).
- Procurement contact: Camille DuPont (camille.dupon@procureco.com) — she handles the initial contracting for pilots.
- Security contact: Rajiv Menon (rajiv.menon@skytech.ai) — will take the SOC2 questionnaire.

We can confirm May 12 for kickoff, but would like the mutual action plan finalized before the calendar invite. Please send the DocuSign when ready.

One additional ask: can you include an example of the expected latency profile for both the high-accuracy and cost-optimized variants based on 8k token context? That will help us size internal expectations.

Thanks,
Erica
Head of Product — Support AI | SkyTech Systems
